description: This file contains implementation of multiple Orleans grain classes related to timers, including TimerGrain, TimerCallGrain, NonReentrantTimerCallGrain, and various Poco and request-based grain classes. These classes demonstrate timing, scheduling, reentrancy control, and timer management within Orleans grains, along with logging and context checks.

classes.name: TimerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing timer functionality with start, stop, and tick logic, including context validation and logging.

classes.name: TimerCallGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain demonstrating timer callbacks with advanced control, including reentrancy checks, timer management, and grain interactions.

classes.name: NonReentrantTimerCallGrain
classes.description: A timer grain that enforces non-reentrancy in timer callbacks, with detailed context and task scheduling validation.

classes.name: PocoTimerGrain
classes.description: A Plain Old CLR Object (POCO) implementation of a grain with timer support, context validation, and logging.

classes.name: PocoTimerCallGrain
classes.description: A POCO grain demonstrating advanced timer functionalities, including restart, stop, self-disposing timers, and grain interactions.

classes.name: PocoNonReentrantTimerCallGrain
classes.description: A POCO implementation of a non-reentrant timer grain, with detailed context, reentrancy, and timer management.

classes.name: TimerRequestGrain
classes.description: A grain that manages timers with start, wait, and overload testing, including timer composition and completion signaling.

classes.name: PocoTimerRequestGrain
classes.description: A POCO version of TimerRequestGrain, with context management and timer registration.

classes.name: PocoNonReentrantTimerRequestGrain
classes.description: A POCO implementation demonstrating non-reentrant timer behavior with context validation.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides activation behavior to initialize context and timers.

methods.name: StopDefaultTimer
methods.description: Stops the default timer registered in the grain.

methods.name: Tick
methods.description: Timer callback that logs tick information and checks context validity.

methods.name: GetTimerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the timer period.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Returns the current counter value.

methods.name: SetCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter value.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer with a specified name.

methods.name: StopTimer
methods.description: Stops a specified timer.

methods.name: LongWait
methods.description: Implements a delay via Thread.Sleep.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeContext
methods.description: Validates that the current runtime context matches the stored context.

methods.name: LogStatus
methods.description: Logs the status and step information for timer callbacks.

methods.name: TimerTickAdvanced
methods.description: Handles advanced timer tick with operation commands like update_period or dispose_timer.

methods.name: ProcessTimerTick
methods.description: Performs grain interactions during timer ticks, including setting values and delay.

methods.name: CheckReentrancy
methods.description: Enforces non-reentrancy by verifying timer callback sequence via GUID.

methods.name: ExternalTick
methods.description: External method to manually trigger a timer tick.

methods.name: StartAndWaitTimerTick
methods.description: Starts a timer and waits for the callback to complete.

methods.name: StartStuckTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer designed to be stuck or long-running.

methods.name: PollCompletedTimers
methods.description: Checks how many timers have completed.

methods.name: TestCompletedTimerResults
methods.description: Validates timer callback results, including state and cancellation properties.
